value: Shaw’s report names Edwin VanCleef as leader of the Stonemasons, the guild that rebuilt Stormwind after the First War. Shaw says the builders were treated poorly after their work. This is his account of the grievance, carried back to Gryan as intelligence. The story shows VanCleef as the subject of that report, not as a participant in the conversation.
editorNote: The labor dispute is attributed to Shaw. Exact contract terms and the full political history remain open to original-client and primary-source review.
